subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — request for onboarding top-up and promo carveout
messages:
From: Sophie Langston <sophie@brightbridge.vc>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: BrightBridge cohort request — supplemental onboarding credits and support

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the cohort loved the latency and cost story. We have our next acceleration cohort kicking off July 1 and two teams are doing heavier model evaluation during onboarding.

We wanted to check whether Redwood can: 1) provide a one-time credit top-up for the cohort (~50k token-equivalent) to cover extended sandbox usage, and 2) carve out pilot onboarding seats (2 engineer-days of priority onboarding + access to the dedicated support channel) to ensure they meet their milestones.

Budget is tight for most of the startups; BrightBridge typically asks partners for a short written mutual action plan and a simple SOW to lock in the supports. From our side we can sign a short SOW, and legal may have a couple of standard redlines — attaching a draft SOW and a forecast of cohort usage.

We’ve attached the redlined SOW and a forecast of cohort usage.

Attachments: BrightBridge_Onboarding_SOW_v3.pdf, cohort_usage_forecast.xlsx

Can you confirm what is possible and any policy constraints for promo/top-up exceptions? Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week.

Best,
Sophie Langston
Program Director, BrightBridge Accelerator
Sophie@brightbridge.vc

Hi Sophie — thanks for the details and the forecast, that helps a lot. Short answer: we can support a one-time top-up and the priority onboarding seats, but we need to align on the mechanics. Proposed options (prefer short bullet list for your ops/legal):

- Option A (trial top-up): One-time 50k free-credit top-up applied to the cohort's sandbox account, no commitment. Includes two priority onboarding seat-days. Ops will set credits to expire 90 days after issue.
- Option B (convertible offer): Reduce top-up to 30k free credits plus a 15% committed discount if BrightBridge converts 1 team to a 6-month Dedicated reservation within 60 days. This helps economics if one or more startups convert.

Operational asks from our side: a one-page SOW (we can use your attached doc), a list of account emails to receive the top-up, and legal sign-off on the standard partner terms (we can accept a narrow set of redlines). I’ve CC'd Marissa (commercial/legal liaison) and Ben (pilot ops) — Marissa can confirm legal scope.

If it helps, we can do a short call tomorrow to finalize which option you prefer and get a mutual action plan into DocuSign.

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Startups & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the clear options. A few quick clarifying points from our side after reviewing with ops/legal:

- Can the top-up be split between two teams? One team will be doing model training and the other primarily embedding/rerank evaluation. We prefer the 50k split 30/20.
- Legal returned a redline to your SOW (see attached "legal_redline_BB_SOW.docx"). Their main asks are: explicit data handling clause for cohort data, a 90-day audit window, and a simple liability cap tied to credits.
- The accelerator is open to Option B (convertible offer) but would prefer a 3-month conversion window (rather than 60 days) to account for investor cycles.

We’ve attached the redlined SOW for your review. If the split/top-up and the 3-month window are workable, we can mark this as urgent and get the mutual action plan signed next week.

Sophie
Program Director, BrightBridge Accelerator

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Langston <sophie@brightbridge.vc>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20 10:05 PDT
Subject: Re: BrightBridge cohort — request for onboarding top-up and promo carveout

Hi all — looping in commercial/legal to close this out. I reviewed BrightBridge's redlines and we can accommodate the request with the following negotiated terms: 

1) Credit top-up: Redwood will issue a one-time 50k free-credit top-up, split 30k/20k across the two team sandbox accounts (we will need exact account emails). Credits expire 120 days after issuance (to give teams a little longer runway).

2) Onboarding support: We will include 2 priority onboarding engineer-days (synchronous) and access to our acceleration Slack channel for the cohort.

3) Legal: Our standard partner terms are acceptable with the following captured in the SOW: data handling section mirroring our privacy controls, a 90-day audit window, and a liability cap equivalent to the value of provided credits. We will not accept open-ended liability or broad indemnities.

4) Convertible commitment: If at least one team converts to a 6-month Dedicated reservation within 90 days of credit issuance, BrightBridge will receive an incremental 15% volume discount applied retroactively to the first month of the Dedicated term.

Next steps: Sophie — if you confirm the account emails and accept the 120-day expiry + 90-day conversion window, I will generate the finalized SOW and push it through DocuSign (link below). I am approving the credit top-up and the support package on a commercial exception basis for this cohort.

DocuSign (SOW): https://www.docusign.net/StartSigning?env=demo&dId=0ab12c3d4e

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
